scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/shared packages/orchestrator packages/worker packages/sandbox packages/skills packages/persistence packages/agent-engines packages/channels packages/scheduler && npm -w packages/persistence run build:migrations && npm -w packages/orchestrator run build:assets && npm -w packages/worker run build:assets && npm run build:pi-runner && npm run build:web
scripts.check: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/shared packages/orchestrator packages/worker packages/sandbox packages/skills packages/persistence packages/agent-engines packages/channels packages/scheduler --pretty
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:orchestrator && npm run test:worker && npm run test:sandbox && npm run test:skills && npm run test:persistence && npm run test:agent-engines && npm run test:channels && npm run test:scheduler
scripts.test:scheduler: tsc -b packages/scheduler --pretty false && node --test packages/scheduler/dist/wiring/*.test.js packages/scheduler/dist/api/*.test.js packages/scheduler/dist/control/board-snapshots/*.test.js packages/scheduler/dist/runtime/*.test.js
scripts.test:channels: tsc -b packages/channels --pretty false && node --test packages/channels/dist/*.test.js packages/channels/dist/board/*.test.js
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/src/*.js packages/*/src/*.js.map packages/*/src/*.d.ts
